The product is alloyed aluminum sheets in cut lengths with thicknesses exceeding 0.2 mm, matching the heading's scope precisely. The 8-digit line 7606.12.30 covers sheets that are not clad. The 10-digit code 7606.12.30.96 (Other) is the appropriate statistical suffix for aluminum alloy sheets not otherwise specified as high-strength heat-treatable alloys, heat-treatable industrial alloys, can stock body or lid stock, or other specifically enumerated categories. memo.argument: Heading 7606 covers aluminum plates, sheets and strip of a thickness exceeding 0.2 mm. The product is alloyed aluminum sheets in cut lengths with thicknesses exceeding 0.2 mm, matching the heading's scope precisely. Chapter 76 Subheading Note 1(b) defines aluminum alloys as metallic substances in which aluminum predominates by weight over each of the other elements, which matches the stated composition. The sheets are not clad (as confirmed by the facts). Under GRI 6, subheading 7606.12 applies to aluminum alloys (as opposed to 7606.11 for non-alloyed aluminum). The 8-digit line 7606.12.30 covers sheets that are not clad. The 10-digit code 7606.12.30.96 (Other) is the appropriate statistical suffix for aluminum alloy sheets not otherwise specified as high-strength heat-treatable alloys, heat-treatable industrial alloys, can stock body or lid stock, or other specifically enumerated categories. Section XV note 1 does not exclude aluminum sheets from chapter 76. The product is not machinery, vehicles, or any other excluded article.
